Use of absolute value with λ=0 and λ=−1 is supported by lem‑of‑abs‑value (|0|=0, |−1|=|1|=1) and lem‑vector‑space‑elementary‑consequences (0·v=0_V, (−1)v=−v). No boundary condition invalidates any claim.
